Since sin entered the world, we have let Satan and his demons help us to become so very vile in our hearts, and now to accept as normal, so many perversions and evil actions. Thank you Lord for your longsuffering and mercy you have shown to us all. Thank you Jesus for your sacrifice to bring us into fellowship with the Father (John 17:3) – Praise God!
